source.note: "Create a project access token" example response. The token value is deliberately shaped like nothing GitLab issues, so no secret scanner can mistake this fixture for a credential (BD-002).
"Revoke a project access token" - "If successful, returns 204 No content."

"404: Not Found if the access token does not exist." Token 59 is a handle this provider never minted: the case where a 404 cannot tell "already revoked" from "never existed here", and the adapter refuses to report success (WP-09 review round 1). A second teardown of a token this provider did revoke sends no request at all, so it needs no fixture.
